map.查询常见危险化学品特性，生成泄漏处置方案与个人防护建议: Look up the properties of common hazardous chemicals and generate a spill-response plan with personal-protection recommendations.
map.化学品泄漏处置按物质毒性等级、挥发性与比重确定防护等级(PPE)、洗消方法与下风: Chemical spill response sets the PPE level, decontamination method and downwind evacuation radius from toxicity, volatility and specific gravity: e.g. chlorine (PPE Level A) ≥500 m downwind, ammonia (PPE Level B) ≥300 m; heavier-than-air gases must not be flushed directly with water.
map.：最高防护，正压自给式呼吸器+全封闭气密型防化服（未知/剧毒物质）: : highest protection, positive-pressure SCBA + fully encapsulating gas-tight suit (unknown/highly toxic substances)
map.：正压自给式呼吸器+非气密型防化服（已知高毒物质）: : positive-pressure SCBA + non-gas-tight chemical suit (known highly toxic substances)
map.：过滤式防毒面具+防化服（低浓度已知物质）: : air-purifying respirator + chemical suit (known substances at low concentration)
map.热区（禁入区）：泄漏源周围，仅A级防护人员进入: Hot zone (no-entry zone): around the spill source, only Level A personnel may enter
map.温区（洗消区）：热区外围，B级防护，设洗消通道: Warm zone (decontamination zone): outside the hot zone, Level B protection, with a decontamination corridor
map.冷区（安全区）：指挥/医疗/集结区，C级或D级防护: Cold zone (safe zone): command/medical/staging area, Level C or D protection
map.化学品事故极度危险！本工具仅供参考，实际处置须依据 SDS（安全数据表）与专业危: Chemical incidents are extremely dangerous! This tool is for reference only; actual response must follow the SDS (safety data sheet) and professional hazardous-chemical handling standards.
map.📚 深度解析：化学品泄漏处置器: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Chemical Spill Response Planner
map.危化品运输事故到场初期，按品名快速确定防护等级、处置剂与疏散警戒范围。: On arrival at the initial stage of a hazmat transport incident, quickly determine the PPE level, treatment agent and evacuation cordon by substance name.
map.企业应急演练中作为情景脚本生成器，按不同化学品与泄漏量生成处置流程与洗消要求。: Used in corporate emergency drills as a scenario-script generator that produces response procedures and decontamination requirements for different chemicals and spill quantities.
map.应急预案编制时核对各化学品的 IDLH、爆炸下限与禁忌处置方式（如氯气严禁直接冲: When drafting emergency plans, verify each chemical's IDLH, lower explosive limit and prohibited treatment methods (e.g. chlorine must not be flushed directly with water).
map.氯气 100 kg 室内泄漏的处置要点: Response key points for a 100 kg indoor chlorine spill
map.按默认参数（氯气 Cl₂、100 kg、室内泄漏、风速 3 m/s）：防护等级: With the default parameters (chlorine Cl₂, 100 kg, indoor spill, wind speed 3 m/s): PPE Level A, downwind cordon 500 m (×1.5 when wind speed >5 m/s, ×1.3 when spill quantity >500 kg); IDLH is only 10 ppm, so positive-pressure SCBA + fully encapsulating suit are mandatory; the treatment agent is an alkaline solution (sodium hydroxide/sodium carbonate) for absorption — never flush with water directly, which would cause secondary hazards, and a decontamination corridor must be set up.
map.警戒距离是怎么算出来的？: How is the cordon distance calculated?
map.以该化学品在数据库里的基准距离为基础（氯气 500 m），再按现场条件放大：风速: It is based on the chemical's baseline distance in the database (500 m for chlorine), then scaled up by field conditions: ×1.5 when wind speed exceeds 5 m/s and ×1.3 when spill quantity exceeds 500 kg; for indoor or large spills the PPE level is raised directly to Level A.
map.IDLH 是「立即危及生命或健康的浓度」，是选择呼吸防护等级的核心依据。IDLH: IDLH is the 'immediately dangerous to life or health' concentration and is the core basis for choosing the respiratory protection level. Highly toxic gases with an IDLH as low as 10 ppm (such as chlorine) require positive-pressure SCBA; air-purifying respirators are not suitable.
map.内置常见危险化学品数据库，根据泄漏物质、泄漏量和场景，生成处置方案、防护等级与疏: A built-in database of common hazardous chemicals generates a response plan, PPE level and evacuation recommendations from the spilled substance, quantity and scenario.
